_doc: Wolf packs (ADR-0055, WolfPack / WolfHunt in src/wildlife/wolves). hunger: 0 fed .. 1 starving; it rises per_hour (game hours) and a new pack rolls it in start; at `hungry` a pack hunts. hunt: the nearest grazer of at least min_prey_health within range (m) of the pack: it stalks at stalk_speed (deer don't see a stalking wolf), and once a wolf is within rush_range all of them run in at rush_speed for at most rush_seconds; a wolf within bite m bites for bite_damage every bite_every s; a failed hunt is tried again after retry_seconds. feed: the pack eats the kill for seconds (hunger to 0, the carcass is left as remains), then beds down by it for rest_hours. guard: a player within radius of a feeding or bedded pack's kill is growled at for warn_seconds, then attacked. day: a pack with no reason to attack keeps avoid m off the player and watches (it walks off at avoid_speed). engage: the pack takes the player on (the hound brain hunts them) when hungry and the player is within day_range by day or night_range at night; at night a pack with at least night_hunger hunger does; a wounded pack within wounded_range does, for wounded_seconds; calm_seconds after its reasons go, it lets the player be. blood: a pack with at least min_hunger hunger follows a player bleeding at least `bleeding` whose trail it smells (scent at a wolf above `scent`). fire: at night a lit campfire or station is a no-go zone of radius m (station_radius for a lit station that isn't a fire): wolves circle outside it. howl: at dusk and night a pack howls about every_hours (game hours, +-50 %), audible m; mates join chorus s apart. No howl is a stimulus: it brings neither the Hollowed nor heat. spawn: at most max_packs alive; a pack is dropped when every wolf is despawn m from the player.
